title: {ça} - Survival Phrases
description: Learn '{ça}' (that/it) and build your first real conversations! Most useful word in French!
can_do: Greet someone and ask how they're doing (ça va?)
Agree with people (c'est ça - that's right)
Use ça in conversation (I have that, it's that)

concepts.definition: Informal, versatile, used constantly in conversation
concepts.example: You'll use this word in almost every sentence!

concepts.definition: That's it / That's right - super common phrase
concepts.example: Used to confirm, agree, or point to something

concepts.definition: How's it going? / Are you OK? - most common greeting!
concepts.example: The first thing you say when meeting someone

concepts.definition: Combine with être and avoir from previous modules

items.situation: Point to something. Use the most versatile word for 'that/it'
Someone shows you what they meant. Confirm by saying 'that's it'
Greet a friend casually. Ask how they're doing
items.cue: How's it going? / Are you OK?

mistakes.feedback: Good! But simpler: just 'ça va' works

items.situation: Someone offers you something. Accept by saying you have/want it
items.hint: Combine avoir + ça (both from previous modules)

items.situation: Tell your friend they have something. Say 'you have that'

mistakes.feedback: Wrong conjugation: tu AS not tu a

items.situation: Confirm someone possesses something. Say 'he has that'

mistakes.feedback: Wrong conjugation: il A not il as
